Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Basic Concepts in RF Design
Week 3: Modulation and Wireless Standards

Week 5: Power Amplifier (PA) part2
Week 6: Transmitter
Week 7: Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA)

Week 9: Oscillator
Week 10-11: Project I: PA design and implementation

Week 13-14: Project II: LNA design and implementation
Week 15: Project II: LNA circuit measurement
Week 16-17: Project III: Oscillator design and implementation
Week 18: Project III: Oscillator circuit measurement
